# rxeval

Runs the logic inside an ODK/OpenRosa form — `relevant`, `constraint`,
`required`, `calculate` — from R, before the field and after it.

A form is a small program. Until something runs it, an analysis script
can only take whatever the devices sent and hope the devices were right.
rxeval is that something: it evaluates the questionnaire’s own rules
over collected data and answers what the form says — and it reads a form
the way **both** engines in the ecosystem do, JavaRosa (ODK Collect,
KoboCollect) and Enketo (web forms), so it can also say where the two
will disagree before anyone collects a byte.

The engine is the [rxeval Rust
crate](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/); this package is the same
engine compiled into R, not a reimplementation.

## Installation

The package compiles its engine on installation, so it needs a [Rust
toolchain](https://rustup.rs) (`rustc` ≥ 1.65):

\
`# install.packages("remotes")`\
`remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_github.html)`(``"milkway/rxeval"``, subdir ``=`` ``"r-package"``)`

## What it answers

Three functions, three questions:

\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`rxeval`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/)`)`\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`dplyr`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org)`)`\
\
`form``       ``<-`` `[`system.file`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/system.file.html)`(``"extdata"``, ``"visit.xml"``, package ``=`` ``"rxeval"``)`\
`submission`` ``<-`` `[`system.file`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/system.file.html)`(``"extdata"``, ``"visit-submission.xml"``, package ``=`` ``"rxeval"``)`\
\
`# Which of the form's own rules does this submission break?`\
[`submission_findings`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/r/reference/submission_findings.md)`(``form``, ``submission``)`` ``|>`\
`  `[`as_tibble`](https://tibble.tidyverse.org/reference/as_tibble.html)`(``)`\
`#> # A tibble: 3 × 3`\
`#>   path                   kind        says`\
`#>   <chr>                  <chr>       <chr>`\
`#> 1 /data/youngest_entered calculation /data/youngest_entered: holds "", but…`\
`#> 2 /data/residents        constraint  /data/residents: More than 20 reside…`\
`#> 3 /data/respondent       required    /data/respondent: required, and unan…`\
\
`# Will this form mean the same thing on a tablet and in a browser?`\
[`form_portability`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/r/reference/form_portability.md)`(``form``)`` ``|>`\
`  `[`filter`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/filter.html)`(``breaks`` ``==`` ``"Collect / KoboCollect"``)`` ``|>`\
`  `[`select`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/select.html)`(``path``, ``construct``, ``suggestion``)`\
`#>                     path construct            suggestion`\
`#> 1 /data/youngest_entered    last() count() of the repeat`\
\
`# What does this rule do, before it goes into the spreadsheet?`\
[`eval_expression`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/r/reference/eval_expression.md)`(``"count(/data/resident[age < 18])"``, ``submission``)`\
`#> [1] "1"`

A rule the engine could not evaluate comes back as `not-evaluated`,
never as a pass: a rule that did not run has not been satisfied, and
reporting it as clean would be the one failure worth avoiding.

## The rest of the family

- [rxform](https://github.com/milkway/rxform) turns an
  [XLSForm](https://xlsform.org) spreadsheet into the XForm this package
  runs.
- [The project site](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/) explains the
  method: every rule in the engine was decided by putting the same
  expression to both reference implementations and reading the two
  answers.

# Package index

## Check a form before the field

The gaps between JavaRosa and Enketo do not announce themselves — an
expression one engine cannot evaluate usually yields nothing rather than
an error.

- [`form_portability()`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/r/reference/form_portability.md)
  : Will this form mean the same thing on a tablet and in a browser?

## Check submissions after it

- [`submission_findings()`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/r/reference/submission_findings.md)
  : What a form's own rules say about a submission

## Try a rule by hand

- [`eval_expression()`](https://milkway.github.io/rxeval/r/reference/eval_expression.md)
  : Evaluate one XPath expression against a submission
